Subject: A gentle reminder about our meeting times

Hi there,

I hope you’re having a wonderful day! I wanted to share a quick thought regarding our upcoming client meetings. Punctuality is a key part of how we present our professionalism to our partners, and I’ve noticed a few recent instances where we’ve arrived a bit later than planned.

To help us stay on track, I’d love for us to make sure we’re arriving on time moving forward. Consistency here really helps us build trust and show our best selves. Let’s work together to ensure we’re always ready and present for our clients.

Thanks so much for your attention to this!

Best regards,

[Your Name]

P.S. Speaking of clouds, did you know that the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from? It’s always nice to look up and appreciate the little wonders while we’re on the go!
